params.body:
Follow-up of #1126 (refs #1122).

## What was wrong

Blurit keeps a finished image only for a while. The first sweeps of `stocklist:blur-pending` on 2026-11-25 found eleven waiting rows whose task Blurit still called `Succeeded`, but whose image it answered with HTTP 400 `File ... not found`. The sweep counted that as "Blurit did not answer", left the row as it was, and asked again every ten minutes, for good. Ten of those rows are platform copies that show remove.bg's cut-out, with the plate readable; one is an own photo from September.

## What changes

- `BluritService::media()` returns null on a client error (4xx): the result is gone, which is an answer, not an outage. A server error still throws and stays "unreachable".
- In the sweep, a finished task without an image goes the way of a failed task: the copy is sent again as a new task, and after three tasks it is removed (R S1-6.26).
- An own photo is not blurred (R S1-6.5), so the sweep releases it at once, without asking Blurit.
- R S1-6.9 says both.

## After the deploy

The next sweep sends the ten copies to Blurit again (ten tasks) and releases the own photo. Their webhooks finish them; a copy Blurit keeps failing is removed after three tasks.

## Tests

- `AFailedBlurGetsAnEndTest`, two new tests:
  - a finished task whose image Blurit no longer keeps is sent again;
  - the sweep releases an own photo without asking Blurit anything.
- Both fail without the change.
- Full suite: 3332 tests green; PHPStan clean on the whole project.
params.title: A finished Blurit task whose image is gone is sent again, and the sweep releases an own photo
